prometheus.title: Prometheus exporter
prometheus.authHint: The endpoint requires the administrator account (HTTP Basic). The values are refreshed by the background checks every minute.

CLUSTER_SINGLE_MEMBER.title: Single member cluster
CLUSTER_SINGLE_MEMBER.description: The cluster has only one data member. Partition backups have nowhere to live, so a restart or crash of this member loses all data and the cluster is unavailable meanwhile.

MAP_UNBOUNDED_NO_TTL.title: Unbounded map without TTL
MAP_UNBOUNDED_NO_TTL.description: The map is large and the sampled entries have neither a time-to-live nor a max idle: nothing ever expires. Without an eviction policy the map grows until the members run out of memory (OutOfMemoryError).

MAP_ZOMBIE_WRITE_ONLY.title: Write-only map (dead cache)
MAP_ZOMBIE_WRITE_ONLY.description: Entries are written to this map but it has never been read: no get operation and no hit since the members started. The data occupies memory without being used by any application.

MAP_BACKUP_DISABLED_OR_BROKEN.title: No backups
MAP_BACKUP_DISABLED_OR_BROKEN.description: The cluster has several data members, but this map holds no backup entries (backup-count is 0). If a member fails, the entries it owned are lost.

MAP_HIGH_LATENCY.title: High map latency
MAP_HIGH_LATENCY.description: The average get or put latency of this map is above the threshold. Clients wait for every operation; typical causes are large values, expensive (de)serialization, MapStore calls or overloaded members.

QUEUE_BACKLOG_GROWTH.title: Queue backlog
QUEUE_BACKLOG_GROWTH.description: The queue holds more items than the backlog threshold: consumers are slower than producers, stuck or not running. The items occupy member memory and are processed late.

DTO_UNREGISTERED_SCHEMA.title: DTO without schema
DTO_UNREGISTERED_SCHEMA.description: Sampled values are IdentifiedDataSerializable objects whose factory id / class id has no schema in the DTO Schema Studio, so they cannot be shown or edited here.

recommendations.CLUSTER_SINGLE_MEMBER: Run at least 3 data members in production (2 is the minimum for backups) and keep backup-count ≥ 1. A single member is fine for development only.
recommendations.MAP_UNBOUNDED_NO_TTL: Configure a time-to-live (time-to-live-seconds) or max idle (max-idle-seconds) and an eviction policy with a size limit (eviction: LRU/LFU, max-size-policy PER_NODE or USED_HEAP_PERCENTAGE), or write entries with map.put(key, value, ttl, unit). If the map is reference data that must never expire, ignore this check for it.
recommendations.MAP_UNBOUNDED_NO_TTL_CRITICAL: The map already uses a lot of memory: add a TTL / max idle and a size based eviction policy now, and check whether old entries can be removed. Until then, watch the heap of the members closely.
recommendations.MAP_ZOMBIE_WRITE_ONLY: Find out whether any application still reads this map. If not, stop writing it and destroy or clear it; if it is only read after a restart or by a batch job, give it a TTL so the data does not pile up.
recommendations.MAP_BACKUP_DISABLED_OR_BROKEN: Set backup-count: 1 (or async-backup-count: 1) in the map configuration of the members. Without backups every member failure loses data; only caches whose data can be reloaded at any time may run without them.
recommendations.MAP_HIGH_LATENCY: Check value sizes, use a faster serialization (Compact or IdentifiedDataSerializable instead of Java Serializable), avoid slow MapStore / EntryProcessor logic, add indexes for queries and look for GC pauses or overloaded members. Near caches help read-heavy maps.
recommendations.QUEUE_BACKLOG_GROWTH: Scale up or fix the consumers, set a max-size on the queue to apply back pressure and consider a QueueStore for large backlogs. Make sure consumers acknowledge and remove items.
recommendations.DTO_UNREGISTERED_SCHEMA: Open the DTO Schema Studio and paste the Java source of this class (and of the factory, so its name is known). Once the schema is saved the values are readable and editable immediately.
recommendations.DTO_UNREGISTERED_SCHEMA_RESTART: The factory id of this class is not served by the DTO Schema Studio yet. Add the schema in the Studio and restart the service, or put the jar with the class and its factory into lib/.
